protocol: Reference-specific concrete cause and supported trigger, identical scoring rules to development. Defined before holdout model calls. Official patch/test-derived and hidden from reviewer. Extra findings scored separately; no automatic false-positive label. Human review pending.

issues.tornado-13: HTTP/1.0 response start lines have no method attribute. _can_keep_alive directly accesses start_line.method when response has no Content-Length or chunked Transfer-Encoding, raising AttributeError instead of completing the response/connection handling.
issues.youtube-dl-14: YouTube chapters may be supplied in webpage RELATED_PLAYER_ARGS/watch_next_response playerOverlay chapter metadata, without timestamp chapters in the description. The old extraction only examines the description and therefore omits valid chapter start/end/title metadata. A concrete missing webpage-JSON extraction path is required; unrelated timestamp parsing is not this reference issue.
issues.tornado-14: IOLoop.initialize(make_current=True) reverses the existing-current condition: it raises current IOLoop already exists when no current loop exists, instead of making the new loop current; the conflict guard must reject when an existing loop is present.
issues.youtube-dl-15: js_to_json token regex consumes e/E inside a valid numeric scientific-notation literal as an identifier, quoting it and corrupting valid JSON numeric output. Require a concrete exponent numeric input, not general identifier or escape advice.
